name: Shizen Restaurante Nikkei
summary: A relaxed, well-regarded Nikkei dinner for sharing many small plates, much cheaper than Maido. Pick it for a casual Nikkei night rather than a destination tasting; its #62 LatAm ranking sits below Maido and Central.

value.text: Tue-Sat lunch 12:30-15:00 and dinner 19:00-22:30; Monday dinner only; Sunday 13:00-16:00 (secondary source).
A la carte; realistic ~US$50-90 pp with drinks (my estimate)
